nodes.label: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? (OPSA)
nodes.author: Yi Ding; Ruqi Zhang
nodes.rationale: Teacher supervision in OPD is shown to be substantially noisy and unnecessary for student improvement; gains are traced to suppressing low-probability sampled tokens, motivating a teacher-free replacement.

nodes.label: On-Policy Self-Adaptation (OPSA)
nodes.rationale: Scaling a fixed negative advantage on low-logp tokens by relative entropy suppresses tail tokens at high-entropy fork positions while leaving confident predictions untouched, avoiding the collapse a flat positive advantage causes.
